build_bilinear_interpolation_helper: build a BilinearInterpolationHelper from packed annotations and DensePose output resolution for loss computation
extract_values_with_bilinear_interpolati: extract estimated values at annotation points using bilinear interpolation with the BilinearInterpolationHelper extract_at_points method
resample_tensor_between_bounding_boxes: resample a tensor from source to destination bounding boxes using grid_sample with configurable interpolation mode
accumulate_and_pack_densepose_annotation: accumulate DensePose annotations across images using ChartBasedAnnotationsAccumulator and pack them into tensors
sample_random_tensor_indices: sample a specified number of random indices from a range using torch.randperm for data subsampling
